name: glasshouse-layout-planner
description: Interactive floor-plan planner for The Glasshouse 236-248 pax hybrid wedding layout

scripts.pack:web: npm run build && rm -f glasshouse-web.zip && cd dist && zip -qr ../glasshouse-web.zip . && cd .. && echo 'wrote glasshouse-web.zip (contents of dist/)'
scripts.pack:lambda: rm -rf lambda/data && cp src/defaultLayout.js lambda/defaultLayout.js && cp -R src/data lambda/data && rm -f layout-lambda.zip && cd lambda && zip -qr ../layout-lambda.zip index.mjs defaultLayout.js package.json data && cd .. && echo 'wrote layout-lambda.zip'
